title: Which loss for which task
summary: Match five tasks with the loss you would train them with.

prompts.text: Predict a house price; large errors should cost much more than small ones
Predict the probability that an email is spam
Classify a handwritten digit as one of 0 to 9
Train a linear classifier that maximizes the margin, with labels $\pm 1$
Predict delivery time when a few records are wildly wrong

options.text: Binary cross-entropy on a sigmoid output
Categorical cross-entropy on a softmax output
Mean absolute error, or the Huber loss
Contrastive (InfoNCE) loss over pairs of embeddings
